newsitem.title: FRANCE: EU wheat faces new threat from Australia -official.
newsitem.headline: EU wheat faces new threat from Australia -official.

text.p: The European Union, already faced with fierce competition from cheap Argentine wheat on world markets, is bracing itself for an Australian selling offensive, a senior EU grain official told Reuters on Friday.
The official said Argentina had already sold a large part of its crop on world markets while Australia had yet to market its bumper crop.
"The Argentine market is over. The new "devil" is the Australian market," the official said.
He estimated Argentina still needed to export up to two million tonnes of wheat this season.
Argentina has already sold three million tonnes of wheat to the world market and was expected to supply some 4.5-5.0 milion tonnes to its Mercosur partners, he said.
Australia is looking to export about 17 million tonnes of wheat from its current crop of 21 million tonnes, the Australian Wheat Board (AWB) said earlier on Friday. --Paris newsroom +331 4221 5432
